rows.text: You stand at the heart of a celebration. The city square of Dolos bustles with excitement as the king prepares to unveil his invention with feigned mystery.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "This city once bore witness to two grand deceptions. The first time, even Zagreus, who managed to fool the other gods, was themself deceived. The second, when a shadowless thief brought forth puzzles to the former king. And now, I shall create the third miracle!" The king pulls back the black veil, revealing seven dice in seven colors spinning on its tray.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "I shall grant every citizen equal rights! As long as the fee is paid, everyone can participate in this game, which is beyond judgment. Seven dice, seven numbers. The more numbers you accurately guess, the better your rewards."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Chance and infinite possibilities — this is the king's invention. The citizens surge forth, eager in the notion that they may strike it rich overnight with the toss of a coin.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Wanna follow the trend and give it a try?

The dice stop, and their numbers are identical to your guess. The success of positive reinforcement burgeons within you, gradually drowning out the warnings of risk. How about another roll? The voices of Dolos' onlookers are starting to melt together.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Clear your head, friend. Do not stake your future on the possibility of slim odds.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: The dice come to a halt, their numbers a far cry from your guess. You ignore the laments of failure — in this moment, only the jubilant cheers of winners can be heard. Hey, don't you want to try again?
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: This city exudes an eerie, sticky sensation — once trapped within, you may not be able to escape its clutches.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: I won't fall for this again.
You have psychological trauma when it comes to lottery-type products
You leave the mad city of Dolos in a frenzied hurry, the relentless sounds of rolling dice echoing behind you.
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
